fields.Name: T078 - Grid Recycle Bin Restore Panel
fields.Description: Exercises the soft-delete / recycle-bin restore path driven by Record Changes snapshots — a code path unrelated to grid rendering, filtering, or standard CRUD.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and go to Data Explorer > Data. Open the 'Products' entity (or 'Events') via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type the name, click the exact match). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. In the grid toolbar (top-right area), look for the Recycle Bin chip (a trash-can-arrow-up icon). If present, click it. Success is the Recycle Bin slide-in panel opening and showing either a list of deleted records each with a 'Restore' button, or a valid 'Recycle Bin is empty' state. Seeing the panel render is success — you do NOT need to actually restore anything. If the chip is not visible (no deleted records or no Delete permission for this entity), that is an acceptable outcome.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Recycle Bin chip opens a slide-in panel titled 'Recycle Bin', OR the chip is legitimately absent (no deletions / no permission)
When the panel opens it shows deleted-record entries with Restore buttons OR a valid empty-state ('Recycle Bin is empty')
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
